b1-anjouk-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Charles Robert's Florin
b1-anjouk-01.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks you what Charles Robert did after the Árpád dynasty died out. You say he defeated the petty kings and introduced a stable gold florin.
b1-anjouk-01.prompt: Tell the official what Charles Robert did about the petty kings and about money.
cues: Say what he did to the petty kings
b1-anjouk-01.target: Károly Róbert legyőzte a kiskirályokat. Bevezette az értékálló aranyforintot.
b1-anjouk-01.english: Charles Robert defeated the petty kings. He introduced the stable gold florin.
b1-anjouk-01.canDo: I can describe the rise of Charles Robert and the defeat of the oligarchs (kiskirályok).

b1-anjouk-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Visegrád Meeting
b1-anjouk-02.scenario: On a visit to the palace at Visegrád, a guide asks you who met there in 1335 and why. You say that three kings agreed to open a new trade route.
b1-anjouk-02.prompt: Tell the guide when the meeting was, which kings were there and what they agreed.
b1-anjouk-02.target: 1335-ben a magyar, a cseh és a lengyel király Visegrádon találkozott. Megállapodtak, hogy új kereskedelmi utat nyitnak.
b1-anjouk-02.english: In 1335 the Hungarian, Bohemian and Polish kings met at Visegrád. They agreed to open a new trade route.
b1-anjouk-02.canDo: I can describe the 1335 Congress of Visegrád and its participants.

b1-anjouk-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Louis the Great
b1-anjouk-03.scenario: In a history class, your teacher asks you why King Louis is called the Great and what he did in 1351. You say he was brave and chivalrous and renewed the Golden Bull.
b1-anjouk-03.prompt: Tell your teacher why Louis was called the Great and what he did in 1351.
cues: Say why people called him the Great
b1-anjouk-03.target: Lajost bátorsága és lovagiassága miatt Nagynak nevezték. 1351-ben megerősítette az Aranybullát.
b1-anjouk-03.english: Because of his courage and chivalry, Louis was called the Great. In 1351 he confirmed the Golden Bull.
b1-anjouk-03.canDo: I can explain why Louis I is remembered as Louis the Great and the knight-king (lovagkirály).

b1-anjouk-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Southern Border
b1-anjouk-04.scenario: At the Hungarian National Museum, a guide asks you why King Sigismund built fortresses in the south. You say that the Ottomans threatened the country after Nicopolis.
b1-anjouk-04.prompt: Tell the guide which empire threatened Hungary and what Sigismund built.
b1-anjouk-04.target: Az Oszmán Birodalom fenyegette az országot. Zsigmond király végvárrendszert épített ki a déli határon.
b1-anjouk-04.english: The Ottoman Empire threatened the country. King Sigismund built a border fortress system on the southern frontier.
b1-anjouk-04.canDo: I can outline Sigismund of Luxembourg's reign as king and Holy Roman Emperor.

b1-anjouk-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Siege of Belgrade
b1-anjouk-05.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks you about the year 1456. You say that the Ottoman sultan besieged Nándorfehérvár and that Hunyadi's army drove him back.
b1-anjouk-05.prompt: Tell the official who besieged Nándorfehérvár in 1456 and what happened.
cues: Say who came to help and how it ended
b1-anjouk-05.target: 1456-ban II. Mehmed szultán ostrom alá vette Nándorfehérvárat. Hunyadi János a keresztesekkel visszaverte a támadást.
b1-anjouk-05.english: In 1456 Sultan Mehmed II besieged Nándorfehérvár. János Hunyadi drove back the attack with the crusaders.
b1-anjouk-05.canDo: I can narrate the siege and triumph of Belgrade / Nándorfehérvár in July 1456.

b1-anjouk-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Four Kings and One Victory
b1-anjouk-consolidation.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks you to name the kings of this period and what each did.
b1-anjouk-consolidation.prompt: Tell the official in a few sentences what Charles Robert, Louis and Hunyadi did.
b1-anjouk-consolidation.target: Károly Róbert bevezette az aranyforintot. Nagy Lajos 1351-ben megerősítette az Aranybullát. 1456-ban Hunyadi János megvédte Nándorfehérvárat.
b1-anjouk-consolidation.english: Charles Robert introduced the gold florin. Louis the Great confirmed the Golden Bull in 1351. In 1456 János Hunyadi defended Nándorfehérvár.
b1-anjouk-consolidation.canDo: I can narrate the complete history of 14th–15th century Hungary from Károly Róbert to Hunyadi János.
